prompt: Michael addition: diethyl malonate (CH2(COOEt)2) + methyl vinyl ketone (CH2=CH-COCH3), NaOEt (cat.). Draw the Michael adduct.
explanation: Soft nucleophile (malonate enolate, stable because flanked by two esters) does 1,4-conjugate addition to the enone — attacks the β-C of the α,β-unsaturated system rather than the carbonyl C. Gives a 1,5-dicarbonyl product.
